tasks.title: Complete a planned preventative maintenance check
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the planned check, information used, work completed and how the result is recorded.

tasks.title: Explain how PPM prevents reactive faults
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Use a real asset or building element to explain how planned maintenance prevents failure, waste or inefficient operation.

tasks.title: Triage a reactive maintenance request
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the job request, information gathered, initial diagnosis, risk considerations and decision to repair or escalate.

tasks.title: Complete and verify a responsive repair
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the selected repair, specification/requirement and the inspection proving satisfactory completion.

tasks.title: Create a digital maintenance record
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Create or show a permitted digital record with the required job information and explain how data is protected.

tasks.title: Produce a written maintenance report
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Produce or show a written report that records the issue, action taken, outstanding concern and escalation where needed.

tasks.title: Explain a repair and outcome to a customer
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Use a real example to explain how you adapted the message, kept the customer informed and checked their understanding.

tasks.title: Coordinate work with another trade or colleague
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Describe or verify how you coordinated with another trade, what each person was responsible for and how the team goal was met.

tasks.title: Review your competence and development needs
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Use recent work to identify what you can undertake independently, where your limits are and what development you need next.

tasks.title: Take ownership of a maintenance job from start to finish
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Use one completed job to explain how you took ownership, communicated, recorded progress, resolved issues and achieved a satisfactory conclusion.
